description_en: Retrieves the access layer diagnostic results
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-controller-detection --db-cluster-id amv-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeControllerDetection

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the regions and zones supported by AnalyticDB for MySQL, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC time)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC time). The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language configuration. Valid values:
zh: Simplified Chinese (default).
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
zh：简体中文（默认语言）。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

items.description_zh: 检测项及检测结果对象
